question: What should households substitute for beef?

steps.text: The question asks for a substitute, so I need the same aisle's published yearly changes, not a guess.

payload.note: Relative published price changes only. Not diet advice.

steps.text: The published figures I need are already in the observations.

Beef was up 5.8% in September 2026. In the same part of the shop, slower price rises were Pork (down 1.3%), Poultry (up 0.4%), Fish (up 1.7%), and Lamb (up 3.0%). Relative published price changes only. Not diet advice.
